ResumeJobForm.LblBrief.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft puede iniciar este trabajo de nuevo desde el principio o intentar reanudar desde la última posición conocida.
Como no siempre es posible determinar la mejor posición de reinicio le dejamos tomar la decisión final.
La última velocidad, el poder y el estado del láser se recuperan automáticamente.
ResumeJobForm.LblDetected.Text: ¡L-ai-SERcraft detectó que el último trabajo no se completó!
ResumeJobForm.RbFromBeginning.Text: Empezar de nuevo desde el inicio [safe]
ResumeJobForm.RbFromSent.Text: Reanudar desde el último comando enviado
ResumeJobForm.RbSomeLines.Text: Reanudar algunas líneas antes de detener
RunFromPositionForm.CbRedoHoming.Text: Posicionar en el punto de partida [$H]
RunFromPositionForm.LblBrief.Text:
Esta característica permite ejecutar el trabajo a partir de una línea específica, omitiendo cualquier movimiento anterior.
L-ai-SERcraft calcula la posición exacta y el estado y coloca el grabador en el estado correcto.
SaveOptionForm.label2.Text:
Si necesita exportar el GCode para utilizarlo fuera de L-ai-SERcraft, por ejemplo con un controlador autónomo, tal vez le resulte útil poder exportar el código de cabecera/pie de página y el código entre cada paso.

NOTA: Si exporta GCode para volver a cargar dentro de L-ai-SERcraft es mejor utilizar la exportación rápida en su lugar.
SettingsForm.LblFooter.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft will enqueue this GCode at the end of any job.
Can be used to push back your engraver in a initial state like going back to zero position
or sending M9 to turn off fan etc.

Here you can use the same syntax of custom buttons.
SettingsForm.LblHeader.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft will append this GCode before starting any job.
You can customize this code, for example adding M8 to turn on fan.

Here you can use the same syntax of custom buttons if you need to push some positioning
related to the specific job is going to be executed.
SettingsForm.LblPasses.Text:
When performing multiple passes L-ai-SERcraft will push this GCode in the between of each passes.
Can be used to move Z down to perform deeper cuts.

Here you can use the same syntax of custom buttons.
SettingsForm.LblWarnOrturAC.Text:
Ortur User: Ortur Firmware (all version up to 137) has a bug on the machining resume that prevents properly using the auto-cooling function.
Please do not use Automatic Cooling with Ortur engraver until a new firmware is released.
SettingsForm.label1.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft use power modulation through G-Code "S command" to produce grayscale tones.
Your laser must support TTL control connected to arduino PIN D11.
If not, please disable PWM support.
SettingsForm.label10.Text:
Without "Continuous Jog" when jog button is pressed L-ai-SERcraft send Jog request with settled speed and movement; and the jog is fully executed to the final position.
If you enable "Continuous Jog" jogging is sent with mouse-down and aborted/interrupted on mouse-up, so you can do approximative positioning but in a very comfortable way.

NOTE: "Continuous Jog" only work with Grbl v1.1 or later, and require table size is correctily configured in Grbl Configuration (Menu "Grbl" -> "Grbl Configuration" $130, $131, $132)
SettingsForm.label11.Text: L-ai-SERcraft no está diseñado para soportar el eje Z, pero si usted tiene un hardware de 3 ejes tal vez pueda encontrar esta opción útil.
SettingsForm.label12.Text:
Some laser diodes can heat-up to much if they run for a long time at the highest power. To prevent diode overheating and increase your laser lifetime you can add some automatic cooling-down cycles that insert some pause during engraivng process.
If Auto Cooling is enabled L-ai-SERcraft will send automatic "feed hold" and "job resume" according with ON-OFF timing configuration.
SettingsForm.label13.Text:
Time ON: this is the maximum time that Laser will stay on during engraving process.
After this time L-ai-SERcraft will send an automatic feed hold to cool down the laser.
SettingsForm.label2.Text: Si está activado L-ai-SERcraft envía un reinicio de software cuando abre la conexión a grbl.
SettingsForm.label20.Text: Time OFF: after this cooling time L-ai-SERcraft will send a resume command to continue engraving job.
SettingsForm.label21.Text:
Advertencia: esta función solo funcionará con versiones grbl > v1.1 con "modo láser" habilitado.
Si utiliza el enfriamiento automático con la versión grbl anterior (o con el modo laser deshabilitado) el laser no se apagará durante las pausas
¡y quemará agujeros en su trabajo!
SettingsForm.label22.Text:
The max resolution available in L-ai-SERcraft is 20 lines/mm (about 500dpi) that is high enough for most user.
If you need higher resolution you can enable "HiRes" and remove this limit.  Be careful: L-ai-SERcraft will need many more resources!
SettingsForm.label23.Text:
Here you can set another sound for success events, like when a job is finished.
Check to enable.
SettingsForm.label24.Text:
Here you can set another warning sound.
This usually fired on a bad GCode command, but your machine can continue operating.
Check to enable.
SettingsForm.label28.Text:
Here you can set an error sound for fatal errors.
This means, your job most likely stopped, and L-ai-SERcraft can not continue the operation.
Check to enable.
SettingsForm.label3.Text:
Connection Protocol:
- UsbSerial: is the most common protocol. Should be used if your engraver is connected to USB or COM port.
- UsbSerial2: an alternative implementation of USB serial to bypass Microsoft SerialPort issues
- Telnet: if you have a WiFi-Telnet bridge. Communication is implemented like a simple telnet client-server.
- LaserWebESP8266: support WiFi connection via WebSocket. Compatible with LaserWeb-ESP8266 software.
SettingsForm.label32.Text:
Here you can set a sound for a successful connection.
Check to enable.
SettingsForm.label36.Text:
Here you can set a sound for disconnection.
Useful for some WiFi connections.
Check to enable.
SettingsForm.label39.Text:
By default L-ai-SERcraft use G0 - rapid movement - to skip white parts of your jobs. This speed up the engraving process but it can result in inaccurate positioning with disappointing results. It is usually possible to improve the results by correctly setting the maximum acceleration and speed values ($ 120,121,122 and $ 110,111,112) in the grbl configuration.

If you disable this feature L-ai-SERcraft will use G1 linear movement at the same job speed, with the result that all the engraving process is done at the same speed. This will slow down the process, but can drammatically improve the result where others approacs fails.
SettingsForm.label4.Text:
Streaming Mode: [Default Buffered]
- Buffered: optimize commands streaming filling up grbl receive buffer [recommended]
- Synchronous: wait for the execution of each command prior to send the very next command [slower but safer]
- RepeatOnError:  same as Synchronous but repeat commands if detect error [experimental]
SettingsForm.label40.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft will warn you if you are going to create a job bigger then your engraver workspace.
Set this flag if you don't whant this safety control.
SettingsForm.label41.Text: With "click 'n jog" enabled a double-click on preview surface will jog to the click position.
SettingsForm.label5.Text: By default L-ai-SERcraft produces engraving lines in both travel directions of the laser head. Some tests have shown that this mode (which is faster) produces lower quality results. If the maximum marking quality is desired, activate this option.
SettingsForm.label6.Text:
Threading Mode: UltraFast, Fast, Quiet, Slow. [Default Fast]
This setting affect the speed of sending thread and the frequency of status report request.
Set slower values if you are experiencing issues.
SettingsForm.label7.Text:
L-ai-SERcraft puede detectar problemas y avisar al usuario de cómo resolverlos.
Si está deshabilitado, todos los problemas se gestionan sin previo aviso.
SettingsForm.label8.Text: Si está activado L-ai-SERcraft envía un reinicio de hardware cuando abre la conexión a grbl. [¡La posición se pierde!]
SettingsForm.label9.Text:
Tipo de firmware
- Grbl: el asombroso firmware para el que LaserGRBL fue desarrollado.
- Smoothie [experimental]: el soporte ha sido añadido recientemente y no está completamente probado.
- Marlin [experimental]: el soporte ha sido añadido recientemente y no está totalmente probado.
- VigoWork [experimental]: soporte para el modelo VG-L7x que no es estándar grbl.
